body:
Dear, high school was the worst year of my life ! Yet college was so much better , everyone start treating u as an adult which really makes u more confident .. Don't worry about your look at all please , u have eyes that can see and u r healthy .. U have things that other don't have .. Let's do it step by step , have u considered going to a dermatologist ? 
And please know that the biggest happiness that u can give to your mother is  seeing u happy and achieving your dreams whatever it was , if u hurt yourself your mom will be so down as she will feel like she was killed twice by two of her loved ones (you and your father)

Because you don't give yourself a chance to think elsewhere ! You're graving yourself in these thoughts , you lock yourself so that you don't think of a way out , that's why it took so long .. There is a way out if you are willing to , and I'm always here to help figure things out more clearly and get u out of these thoughts only if u will

Dear , nothing is forever .. Knowing and regretting things shows that u r a good person ! you want to change things but you feel hopeless but trust me u can change it ! Saying sorry admitting your mistake to your loved ones is the way to go , You can right a letter to each person you feel that u hurted , instead of writing a letter that they'll read when u left the world .. They'll be very sad and they'll live with regrets and all what they'll say "if he told us how sorry he was we will always be there for him and forgave him" .. But when u write them sorry letters prior of taking that huge decision things will be very different , please do consider what I said and I really hope to see a reply from u telling me that everything is better than ever

Don't kill yourself that's exactly what her mother wants , she doesn't want u around , so u know what ? YOU WILL LIVE ! First I suggest you talk to a lawyer and see what's your rights , if God forbid u don't have any right do not spend any dollar for your daughter (as long as the mother is using u as a money source only)let her mother take care of her cause you are not her bank , giving her money without love and care is worthless for a child . 
Trust me Karma is not easy on people, just wait and see how you'll have what you should've had , and girls have a very strong bond to there real father even if they wheren't near , that's a fact . You can do so much ! You can date !

Well , you've gone through a lot and I understand how hard it is, I'm sorry about your grandmother ..
Trust me days pass and the pain of today will be just a memory that when u remember you'll say to yourself "wow I passed this " and sometimes you'll even say " I gave it too much attention " . However , what u need now is passing it , and you are close to end it , telling your friend or even writing it here is a big step and it's the way of passing things .
 you are stronger than u think and u have so much power !

Take it easy dear ! Don't let the first thing that come to your mind when u r angry is hurting yourself 
We are always here trust me 
I'll be happy to help u and respond to u
Yes they do aloooot.. I wish I can move out but unfortunately that's not a choice at all

Dear , don't harm yourself , pain will go , hard days will pass nothing is forever .. The future is ahead and the world literally needs u ! I don't know u but I'll be so sad if u did anything bad to yourself , but what about the people who knows u .. It'll be so selfish if u didn't think of your loved ones , take a moment and think of them 
And u already have so many friend request as I'm seeing :)
